---
title: "Infographic Visualizations"
format: pdf
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse) # general use
library(janitor) # cleaning data 
library(here) # data organization 
library(lubridate) # date and time 
library(naniar) # to use gg_miss_var

biomass <- read.csv(here("data", 
                      "annual_all_species_fish.csv"),
                 # changing -99999 values to be na
                 na = "-99999")

sst <- read.csv(here("data", "SST_update2023.csv"))

bottom_temp <- read.csv(here("data", "Bottom_temp_all_years.csv"))
```

```{r}
biomass_clean <- biomass |> 
  clean_names() |>  
  filter(common_name %in% c("California Sheephead", "Red Urchin", "Purple Urchin", "Giant Kelp")) |> 
  rename(original_date = date) |>  
  mutate(
    date = ymd(original_date),
    start_of_year = floor_date(date, unit = "year")) |>
  drop_na(dry_gm2) |> 
  group_by(start_of_year,
           common_name) |> 
  summarize(mean_dry_gm2 = mean(dry_gm2)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  relocate(common_name, start_of_year, mean_dry_gm2)

bottom_temp_clean <- bottom_temp |> 
  clean_names() |>  
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date_local),
    start_of_year = floor_date(date, unit = "year")) |>
  group_by(start_of_year) |> 
  drop_na(temp_c) |> 
  summarize(mean_temp_c = mean(temp_c)) |> 
  # ungrouping the data 
  ungroup() |> 
  relocate(start_of_year, mean_temp_c) 
```

```{r}
biomass_bottom_temp <- full_join(
  biomass_clean,
  bottom_temp_clean,
  by = c("start_of_year"))
```

```{r}
#| label: visualizing-missing-data

biomass_bottom_temp |> 
  gg_miss_var(facet = common_name)

```


```{r}
# species mean dry biomass  timeseries 
ggplot(biomass_clean) + 
  aes(x = start_of_year,
           y = mean_dry_gm2, 
           color = common_name) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point(size = 0.5) + 
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 years", 
               date_labels = "%Y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Giant Kelp" = "seagreen",
    "California Sheephead" = "dodgerblue4",
    "Purple Urchin" = "purple",
    "Red Urchin" = "firebrick")) + 
  labs(
    x = "Time (years)",
    y = "Mean dry biomass (g/m^2)") +
   theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "NONE")
```

```{r}
# time series mean temperature 

ggplot(bottom_temp_clean) + 
  aes(x = start_of_year,
           # y-axis: abundance
           y = mean_temp_c)+ 
  # first layer: geom_line
  geom_line(color = "sienna2") + 
  # second layer: geom_point
  geom_point(
    color = "sienna2",
    size = 0.5) + 
  # faceting by species
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 years", 
               date_labels = "%Y") + 
   labs(
    x = "Time (years)",
    y = "Temperature (celcius)") +
  theme_minimal()


```
